hypothesis.statement: exists (w, c, psi construction, encoding family) such that under A2, at most 2^40 effective queries, and R_plain <= 3, the attacker's compact semantic model success rate is below 0.10

test_distribution.description: normal = valid program inputs from the workload generator; boundary = empty/maximal/zero-length/overflow-adjacent inputs; adaptive = inputs chosen by the attacker based on previous observations, drawn from the same value space

stage1.affine_test: exhaustive over pi_A(K) when its dimension <= 16, otherwise sampled second derivatives with reported sample count and confidence bound

query_counting: one effective query = one attacker-chosen input plus the VM single-step transition and its agreed observation; a trace of length L counts as L transition queries
a2_memory_scope: attacker may read and write the VM state buffer, its bytecode, dispatch tables and checkpoints; may replace call targets and hook the step boundary; may not modify the kernel code image (that is A3)

reporting.censoring: if the registered budget was not exhausted, the report must set censored=true and may only state 'no success within the used budget'
